name: cs-weekly-brief
title: Weekly CSM Brief
description: Write a weekly brief for one CSM's book of accounts: top accounts to act on, renewals in 120 days, expansion signals, and data gaps. Use when the user asks for a weekly brief, a book review, or what to focus on this week, and provides account data.

tools.for: score one CSM's book and write every weekly report (use its scored.csv)

name: cs-account-review
title: Account Review
description: Write a one-page review of a single customer account: snapshot, what's going well, risks, stakeholder map, next actions, and data gaps. Use when the user asks to review, summarize, or assess one account.

name: cs-churn-triage
title: Churn Risk Triage
description: Rank a list of accounts by churn risk with the top drivers and a recommended action for each. Use when the user asks which accounts are at risk of churning, or to triage a book by risk.

name: cs-renewal-prep
title: Renewal Prep
description: Prepare a CSM for one account's renewal conversation: timeline, value story, risks, objections, expansion, and questions. Use when the user is preparing for a specific renewal.

name: cs-pre-renewal-check
title: Pre-Renewal Check
description: Check every account renewing in the next 120 days and give each a readiness status (Ready, Needs work, At risk, Unclear). Use when the user asks about upcoming renewals across a book.

tools.for: list the accounts renewing in 120 days

name: cs-redline-summary
title: Contract Redline Summary
description: Summarize a customer's proposed contract changes (MSA, SOW, SLA) in plain language and route each to the function that owns it. Use when the user shares a redline or a list of contract changes. Not legal advice.

name: cs-handoff-packet
title: Handoff Packet
description: Draft the Sales-to-CS handoff packet for a closed-won deal from deal notes, calls, and emails. Use when the user asks to prepare a handoff or summarize a new customer for the CSM.

name: cs-escalation-summary
title: Escalation Summary
description: Draft the write-up that opens a customer escalation (level, required fields, gaps), or the summary that closes one (outcome, root cause tag). Use when the user is opening or closing an escalation.

name: cs-customer-email
title: Customer Email
description: Draft a customer-facing email for a CSM to review and send. Use when the user asks for a follow-up, update, meeting request, or other email to a customer.

name: cs-qbr-outline
title: QBR Outline
description: Draft a slide-by-slide outline for a quarterly business review built on the customer's goals and outcomes. Use when the user is preparing a QBR or business review.

name: cs-account-update
title: Internal Account Update
description: Write a short internal status update on one account for a manager, account team, or leadership. Use when the user asks for an account update, status note, or summary for internal stakeholders.

name: cs-competency-evaluation
title: CSM Competency Evaluation
description: Gather evidence from a CSM's work samples against the CSM competency framework, area by area. Use when a manager asks to assess, coach, or prepare a review for a CSM.

name: cs-success-plan
title: Success Plan Builder
description: Draft a success plan from kickoff material: 3 to 4 outcomes from the Outcome Library, each with a customer owner, baseline, and target, or repair goals with no baseline or gone stale. Use when the user is starting a customer's success plan or fixing an unmeasured one.

tools.for: find goals with no baseline or gone stale, for a repair

name: cs-adoption-plan
title: Adoption Plan
description: Turn success plan goals with an adoption gap into a plan by feature: who, action, owners, and dates, plus what to check for goals that are not converting. Use when the user asks how to get a customer using the features behind their outcomes.

name: cs-value-narrative
title: Value Narrative
description: Write the story of value delivered from a value report or one account's outcome progress, for a customer executive, CS leadership, the exec team, or the board. Use when the user asks to show or report the value CS or the product has delivered.

tools.for: add the scorecard, for leadership audiences

name: cs-team-brief
title: Team Brief
description: Draft a CS director's weekly brief across the team from the team rollup and renewal forecast: calls to challenge, risk by CSM, capacity, and data gaps. Use when a director or manager asks for a team review, team brief, or forecast review.

tools.for: roll the book up by CSM
